name: BCC Grid Rendering
definition: Using a Body-Centered Cartesian (BCC) grid instead of a cubic Cartesian (CC) grid to reduce the number of required sample points while maintaining lossless compression for spherically bandlimited signals.
summary: BCC Grid Rendering uses a Body-Centered Cartesian lattice to reduce memory and computation by 30% compared to standard Cubic grids while maintaining lossless compression for isotropic signals.
